milestone.label: v0.16 - Supabase auth + Stripe subscriptions + live TICA data pipeline

items: Judge-panel coverage polish: intl coverage grows as the daily cron converges; re-check cadence for clubs that post panels late
Multi-user ownership model (docs/AUTH-OWNERSHIP-DESIGN.md): MERGED co-ownership (shared writes both see), email invite notification, reg-number join requests + certificate verification
Auth polish: email OTP code / verification edge cases

Security (docs/SECURITY.md): sprint 2026-06-30..07-02 (v0.17.2-0.17.10). DONE: CSP+headers (run_worker_first), rate limits, audit log, prototype-pollution guard, shared-cat payload sanitization, seed-share owner-check, DB advisor lockdown (migration 0006), judge-rating anti-ballot-stuffing, supabase-js confirmed latest, leaked webhook revoked, rotation runbook. **P1-7 DONE + verified live: per-user state migrated to Postgres user_state with RLS (migration 0007); dual-write KV+PG, STATE_READ=pg flag + KV fallback/lazy-backfill; RLS isolation proven (own-row-only/anon-denied); view-as+sharing stay on KV; cost-neutral (free tier) + cron keep-warm.** **Turnstile widget CREATED + site key wired + deployed (v0.17.12, 2026-07-02): managed-mode widget for ring.yesandeverything.com, TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY var live, /api/config serves it, CSP opens challenges.cloudflare.com, login renders widget + passes captchaToken; verified turnstile.render() accepts the key on the live hostname.** **Turnstile ENFORCING (2026-07-03): Kane pasted the secret into Supabase CAPTCHA; verified live, OTP without captcha_token now returns captcha_failed.** OPEN: full relational cats/shows normalization (optional product-scale), move view-as/sharing reads to DEFINER RPCs. Ring Resources Bot webhook recreated 2026-07-06 (real URL on disk, audit digests posting again).

barRaise.topFinding: Health moved 73 to 64 this run, the sharpest single-week drop yet, and it's real rather than an artifact of running more lenses: twelve of last week's open findings turned five runs old simultaneously (data-integrity-01/02, compliance-01, pwa-sync-01, cost-economics-01, architecture-01, observability-02, compliance-02, security-02, reliability-04, dependency-02, auth-token-hygiene-02), meaning nothing from the very first bar-raise on 2026-07-07 has been touched in a month, and none of last week's 27 open actions closed this run. The state-sync bug is the one with real teeth: mergeStates() still replaces decisionsList/judgeStatus/myVotes/catTargets wholesale instead of merging them, now confirmed to drop edits on a single-device reboot (not just cross-device), and it pairs with a dual-write path (KV plus Postgres) that discards pgStateWrite's failure result -- with STATE_READ=pg now live in production, a lost Postgres write silently reverts a user's latest decision with nothing surfaced anywhere. Two new HIGH findings landed in the same window a HIGH voice finding was fixed: an em dash still reaches the public status/data/Ring.json through .project-context.json, the same defect shape as the index.html fix from a week ago, and auth-token-hygiene got measurably worse (GET /api/state now pays two serial live Supabase round-trips per request instead of one KV read). Commit history for the past two weeks is almost entirely release-tooling and voice hardening -- strategic-kill-this-01 already called this out a week ago asking for a product-decision session instead; that session still hasn't happened, and six of those days had zero commits at all.

actions.title: Give schedulePush a retry-with-backoff path (or re-arm on next app-visible) and a not-synced indicator instead of swallowing push failures silently.

Check pgStateWrite's return value in handleStatePost and retry or log on failure, so a lost Postgres write in the KV+Postgres dual-write can't silently revert a user's state now that STATE_READ=pg is live.

Add timestamp-aware conflict handling to mergeStates() so decisionsList, judgeStatus, myVotes, and catTargets union instead of getting replaced wholesale on sync; confirmed this run to also drop edits on a single-device reboot, not just cross-device.

Bump public/sw.js's VERSION constant on every release (it's still yar-v0.17.17, 7+ releases stale) so the cache namespace rotates and orphaned entries get pruned; wire it into scripts/release.ps1 alongside the __RING_BUILD stamp.
Back up the KV-only community judge ratings to a Postgres mirror or a scheduled snapshot.

Commit a runnable single-cat-extraction leak test and an npm test script, or correct SECURITY.md's claim that the leak test and view-as gate are unit-tested -- no test file exists anywhere in the repo.
Add console.error to every silent catch block in the TICA-scraping and billing handlers (only one console.error exists in the whole codebase) so a systemic break stops being invisible.

Spend the next Ring session on the v1.0-freeze-vs-Phase-2-scope decision and the pricing question instead of further release-script hardening; the session this was flagged to force a week ago still hasn't happened, and six more days have passed with zero commits.
Add authenticated user-data export and delete endpoints plus a documented retention policy -- no such endpoint exists anywhere in the Worker.

Cache or JWKS-verify Supabase tokens so verifyUser stops paying a live round-trip on every authenticated request -- GET /api/state now pays two serial live Supabase calls per request (verifyUser then pgStateRead) since STATE_READ flipped to pg, worsening the original finding.

Add a release-time grep gate for em dashes and AI-tell vocabulary across every public_artifact_globs path, and extend voice_scope to cover .project-context.json and CLAUDE.md itself -- every catch to date, including last week's fix, has been manual and reactive.
Move view-as and shared-cats reads onto SECURITY DEFINER RPCs to match the RLS-backed isolation already shipped for own-data reads.
Raise or make dynamic standTable's 14-page hard cap (completed seasons already run 11+ pages deep) and log when the walk is terminated by hitting the cap rather than by running out of rows.
Section public/app.js into documented layers matching PROJECT_SPEC.md's module list -- only 4 section markers exist across 2516 lines and the labels no longer describe what's under them.
Apply AbortSignal.timeout to the Stripe, Supabase, Discord, and Resend fetches the way TICA fetches already do.
Skip the multi-cat picker grid and land directly on the single cat's dashboard when myCats().length === 1 -- the picker costs a click on every visit for the one real user.
Bump the wrangler devDependency to the major actually in use (pinned ^3.90.0, actually running 4.123.0 via npx) and commit a lockfile.
Wire a persistent log sink (Discord post, reusing the existing feedback-webhook pattern) for cron and scraper failures instead of relying on the ephemeral live tail.
Have scheduled() write a lastCronRun/lastCronOk marker to KV and surface it in /api/health, distinct from the existing calendarAgeMin freshness proxy.

Hold off wiring readers/writers to the ten multi-user ownership tables (cat_members, cat_invites, cat_verifications) migrated a month ago with zero usage until the v1.0-vs-Phase-2 decision is actually made.
Extract git-guard.ps1 into one shared portfolio script -- the PS5.1 git-stderr fix has now been independently re-derived in at least four projects (Ring, Skylight, Agents, Chains).
Publish a short privacy/terms page naming the data collected (email, TICA reg, Stripe status) and its retention behavior -- none exists anywhere in the repo or on the live site.

Wrap the Step 4 Discord-notify invocation in release.ps1 in the same try/catch pattern as Steps 3 and 5 so an uncaught error in discord-notify.ps1 can't abort the release and skip audit-digest posting.
Build the missing Ring Audit Bot / Ring Backlog Bot webhooks (only 3 of 5 documented webhooks exist) or trim CLAUDE.md's table down to the three channels that actually receive posts.
Reconcile .project-context.json's milestone block: the label still frames auth+billing as the open target while the same file's shipped_since_last_anchor already lists them as done.
Parallelize the sequential per-grant KV reads in handleSharedCats with Promise.all.
Distinguish 'no remote row' from 'read failed' in loadRemoteState so a transient GET failure on boot can't overwrite a newer remote state with stale local data.
Add a console.warn (or a shared swallow() helper) to the silent sync-path catches in app.js (schedulePush, loadRemoteState) so a failed background push leaves a trace.
Document which TICA pages/markup shapes each of the five hand-written scraping parsers depends on, so a silent TICA redesign is triaged fast instead of re-discovered from scratch.

Add CLAUDE.md and .project-context.json to voice_scope -- CLAUDE.md already claims itself as covered but the scope list omits it, and .project-context.json is proven to leak content onto a public surface.
Add Stripe billing/subscriptions to the YaE Ring Details page -- neither the index nor design page mentions it, even though it's shipped, live infrastructure.
Move the judge fav/dis tally to an atomic Postgres UPDATE or explicitly document the accepted KV read-modify-write race.
Log a warning whenever the KV-backed rate limiter falls back to fail-open so a dead RATINGS binding is visible (also closes a security blind spot on the same code path).
Stop paying a KV write on every rate-limit check (the state-autosave debounce half of this finding is now resolved; the per-request rate-limit write is not).
Record the vendored supabase-js version and pull date in a header comment on public/vendor/supabase.js.
Wrap the /api/* route dispatch in a top-level try/catch that returns a JSON 500 with security headers, as a backstop for handler bugs that currently fall through to Cloudflare's generic error page.
Add data/scoring.json to the service worker's SHELL precache array alongside seed.json.

Revisit pricing/unit economics; $1/mo needs roughly 500 users to cover hosting.
Judge-panel coverage polish, auth OTP edge cases, and the DEFINER-RPC migration for view-as/sharing.
